title: A garden to enjoy all year round
intro: We design and care for outdoor spaces suited to the Mediterranean climate, your home and the time you want to spend maintaining them.
aboutTitle: Beauty, shade and balance in every corner
about: We consider orientation, soil, irrigation and how the space will be used to create a balanced garden that is easy to enjoy.
servicesIntro: Solutions for homes, communities, accommodation and small businesses.

d2: Pruning, cleaning, growth control, lawn care and seasonal attention.

d4: Renewal of borders and the addition of trees, shrubs and Mediterranean plants.
